description:
Make the root `AGENTS.md` the single agent guide and state how crate-local guides refine it.

## Background

`CLAUDE.md` is a short pointer file telling agents to read `AGENTS.md`. The root `AGENTS.md` does not state that its rules apply recursively or how a crate-local `AGENTS.md` may add constraints.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `CLAUDE.md` is a repository symlink to `AGENTS.md`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The root `AGENTS.md` states that its rules apply recursively, that a crate-local `AGENTS.md` adds only crate-specific constraints without restating root policy, and that every `AGENTS.md` stays at or below 200 lines.
- [hard] REQ-03: The root `AGENTS.md` remains at or below 200 lines.
- [hard] REQ-04: Tooling that reads `CLAUDE.md` or the old pointer text (gate prompts, hooks, scripts) still works, verified by a repository search recorded in the commit message.
title: Make CLAUDE.md a symlink and define AGENTS.md scope
